newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks up in quiet London market.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks up in quiet London market.

text.p: Trading in Hong Kong shares in London was quiet on Friday after an exuberant market in Hong Kong, dealers said, with gains in HSBC Holdings providing the main highlight.
London's Hang Seng London Reference Index closed up 28.31 points at 11,787.70, extending a 123.26-point rise in the Hang Seng earlier today.
Trading in Anglo-Hong Kong banking group HSBC, up on the back of a rising FTSE 100, was the main focus of interest and traders said they expected the market to come in for profit-taking next week.
"It has been very quiet and Friday-ish," said one trader. "There was no other movement whatsoever."
